scope: Independent fixed-source, artifact, expectation and subprocess review. Generator inspected but never executed; author oracle not imported or called. No sandbox, build, branch change or commit performed by reviewer.

sourceReview.domain: Flexport itself supplies 1<=|s|<=1000 and 0<=n,x,y<=2500. Returns explicitly requires distinct subsequences modulo 1000000007. No x<=n or y<=n restriction is invented.
sourceReview.interpretation: Finite number line 0..n and j+-1 transitions require a valid path to remain inside this domain. Out-of-domain endpoints yield no valid path. The ordinary subsequence definition permits deleting every character; the empty sequence contributes one exactly for valid x=y.
sourceReview.corroboration: Fixed fastprep/Meesho/meesho-distinct-moves.md independently supplies matching interface, movement, modulus and numeric bounds, plus explicit character-string deduplication and deletion definition. Read in full and both SHA256/git blob checked. Package/editorial correctly identify these notes as corroboration rather than literal Flexport wording.
sourceReview.correctionDisclosure: Original input retained; incorrect 3 openly corrected to 2. Unavailable author-local image is not claimed as evidence. Other public examples identified as site-derived.

verification.oracleMethod: Independent forward earliest-embedding DAG: precompute next l/r positions, start with empty prefix at x, propagate each prefix only through its earliest next character, exclude out-of-domain moves, aggregate arrivals at y over all terminal embedding states. This differs from the author's backward suffix DAG and reference last-contribution subtraction.
verification.shortCrossCheck: Independently enumerate index masks, deduplicate complete character strings, then simulate every intermediate position. Applied to all short oracle/formal inputs.
verification.referenceSubprocessResult: All exit zero with empty stderr and output tokens equal independently recomputed expectations.
verification.boundaryCoverage: n=2500, endpoints=2500, n=0, out-of-domain endpoints, lower/upper boundary excursions, all identical characters, alternation, long runs, mixed random input, empty-sequence contribution, modulo wraparound.
verification.exhaustiveDomain: Every lr string of length 1..7, n=0..3, x/y=0..4; independently compare bitmask string-set simulation and forward DAG.

exactIntegerCrossCheck.method: Forward DAG with modulo disabled; no floating-point conversion.

verification.artifactBindings: Normalized package checksum, reference byte hash, batch authored solution, editorial solution/text, primary and corroborating source hashes all verified against frozen artifacts.

negativeControlResult: All 102 runs exit normally without stderr. Rejection indices exactly match authored validation; 14 and 12 cases respectively.
proofReview: Appending a fixed character is injective on distinct prefix strings. The intersection with previously counted strings ending in that character is exactly the previous occurrence's appended set; shifting the last occurrence preserves the string and its trajectory. Endpoint-indexed subtraction therefore removes precisely duplicates, including under bounded-path filtering. Reference uses O(|s|*(n+1)) time and O(n+1) space.
